</text>

<tspan x="653.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>

sourceProfile.shape_origin: declared example; statically inferred, not observed
sourceProfile.drawing_scope: Only ActNorm with logdet=True; reverse is documented, not drawn as forward.

sourceFacts: loc and scale are learned Parameters, initialized from the first input under no_grad; initialized is a uint8 buffer.
Returned logdet is one scalar shared across batch, not a per-example vector. The data stream and determinant are separate outputs.
Reverse is output/scale-loc. Source torch.std default is left version-dependent.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
